My 0.06 hectare plot has enset and some fruit trees growing together with other crops. I do not use chemical fertilizer here because what little I can obtain from the cooperative goes to my cereal plots, but I always spread manure and compost from my homestead. My children and I will do all the weeding, pruning, and harvesting ourselves this season without hiring anyone.
